utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — just check when you can, and I’ll keep a spot open for you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the book club is actually happening tonight, and what book we’re reading? I’d rather not head over if it’s still undecided.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking now, but I don’t want to guess — if it’s still undecided, I’ll let you know right away. I’ll confirm the book and whether we’re on for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet — I’d want the date confirmed first, and then we can make sure everyone can get a copy in time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense — once the date’s locked in, I can help nudge folks to grab copies early. Keep me posted and I’ll pitch in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I will. Once the date’s set, I’ll let everyone know so we can make sure copies are sorted in time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Mara — I’ll keep it friendly and easy to jump into. Once we pick a date and place, I’ll share the first few book choices with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect, Rosa — thanks for helping keep it welcoming. I’ll send over a few lively options, and then we can lock in the date and place together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — I’m looking forward to your options. Once I have them, I’ll help narrow things down and make sure we’ve got a good date and spot for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, did we settle on the next book club pick yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’d love to hear what book you picked this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — we were down to a couple options. Do you remember which one we were leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re leaning toward next Thursday evening in the community room, and I’m checking on a couple more chairs and some snacks. Want me to ask what they picked for the next book?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great—please ask, and I’ll repeat the pick at book club so everyone’s on the same page. Next Thursday in the community room sounds good too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask and let you know what they pick. If it runs late, I can also check the start time for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be kind, thank you. I can make Thursday if it’s not too late.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check whether Thursday’s official and let you know right away — don’t head over until I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Tess. I’ll wait for your confirmation and keep Thursday open for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli — I’m still waiting on the final time, but it sounds like a pretty relaxed small-group thing. I’m also catching up on which book we’re on, so I’m a bit behind too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries — we’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month. I’ll share the final time and the discussion questions as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh nice, thanks — that helps a lot. Send me the final time when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep an eye out for the questions too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds perfect, Gus — that mix should keep it fun and easy for everyone to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’m happy to help make it easy for everyone. If you need setup or a few extra chairs, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep you posted if we need anything. A few extra chairs would be great if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, so I don’t want to guess—I'll confirm which option we’re leaning toward and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — thanks, Hana. I’m happy to wait for the final pick, and I’ll join in when I can as usual.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll verify the options and get back to you once I’ve confirmed the final pick.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Opal — just let me know the headcount, and I’ll keep the snacks and extra chairs ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep track and let you know the headcount as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll be ready with the snacks and extra chairs once you have the count.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7 pm still sounds good for me — I’ll confirm after school pickup and message you right away if I’m running late.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — 7 works for me too. Just let me know if you end up running late.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll confirm after pickup, and I’ll text you right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the book club right away. Want me to invite anyone in particular?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — just invite anyone who’s interested, and if you hear the book title, let me know. I’ll keep track of the snacks and extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll invite a few folks who’d enjoy it, and I’ll let you know the book title as soon as I hear it. Thanks for handling the snacks and extra chairs!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—just let me know the headcount when you have it, and I’ll keep the snacks and pens ready for book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll check on the headcount and get back to you, so we can keep everything ready for book club.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—thanks, Tess. I’ll keep the snacks and pens ready, and we’ll be set once you have the count.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check what they picked and whether Thursday’s start time is set, then let you know. I’m also still asking about a couple more chairs and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — please send me the start time and location when you have them, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check the start time and location, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the time or the book pick?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the final time and the book pick from the others, but I’ll text you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — just let me know when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, got it — thanks. I’ll wait for the final pick and the meeting details, then I can grab a copy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — once the pick’s settled, I can help with setup and bring those extra chairs again if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out for the final pick and let you know if I can help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll invite Mira and Ben and send you the details tonight. If you think of anyone else for book club, I’m happy to loop them in too!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. Just Mira and Ben is perfect—I’ll bring the short novel on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll make sure Mira and Ben get invited, and I’ll see you Thursday with the short novel!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7 pm still sounds good — I’ll know more after school pickup and I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7 pm works for me. I’ll bring the discussion questions and keep an eye out for your text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Eli — I appreciate that. I’ll text you after pickup if I’m running behind.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club—thanks for the reminder. I’m still a little fuzzy on the title, but I’d be glad to come and hear what everyone thinks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — I’m not sure of the title yet either. Want to check the group chat together before we go?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, please — that’d help me a lot. I’m happy to check it with you so I don’t show up half-remembering again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m going to check the two options first, then I’ll confirm which one we’re leaning toward.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great — once you know, could you also confirm the date? I’m trying to make sure everyone can get a copy in time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the pick and the date once I check the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks—just let me know the options, and I’ll pick one that’s lively enough to keep the discussion going.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—let’s keep it easy and lively. A good mystery or a funny novel should do the trick.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A mystery sounds perfect to me—something with a few twists would keep everyone talking.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s still pretty small and cozy, just a few of us chatting about the book. I’m a bit fuzzy on which one we’re on, but it’s been nice so far.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely — a small, cozy book club is the best kind. If you want, I can help figure out which book you’re on and what to read next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks — I could use the help keeping track of which book we’re on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll send over a few lively options for us to pick from. And 7 pm still works fine; we can shift a bit if needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send the options when you can, and we’ll pick one. 7 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll send a few lively options over soon, and then we can all choose the one that sounds most fun to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm whether the book club is actually on tonight? I’d rather not come over if it’s still undecided.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have the final date and time confirmed yet, so I can’t say it’s on tonight. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please let me know when it’s confirmed.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
